name: Aizawa Ayumu
source:
Son of Misaki. He is a first-year student at Ijikuri private school. He has an honest, bright, and gentle personality, but he is slow to grow up and his attitude and tone of voice are girl-like.

He becomes curious about sex when he catches his mother masturbating to mother/son incest manga.
